meta.title: Approver approves an intake with remarks; workflow and Comments tab update
gaps: Open the submitted intake request as its current approver and approve it with a remark.
Verify the intake workflow shows the approver's name and approval timestamp.
Verify the intake request's Comments tab shows the submitted remark.
